clauses.clause: Corgi stiffen/growl/bark before an off-screen infected appears in ≥ 80 % of first encounters.
clauses.note: Fresh natural seed1–10 trials at both qualities on frozen source:20/20 valid first offscreen-to-production-camera appearances. Same-ID actual stiffen/growl/bark event strictly precedes appearance10/10 low and10/10 high (100% each, target80%). Missing encounter, wrong threat ID and late-warning mutations all reject. Ordinary complete keyboard InputFrames; no protection/spawn/relocation. Appearance uses the production View camera/frustum; this is event timing, not an audio-audibility or gesture-polish verdict.
